1.english_reference: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּמְלִיכוּ֩ יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֤ וֹ הַ קָּטֹן֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τὸν Ὀχοζείαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μικρὸν ἀντ᾽ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Constituérunt autem habitatóres Ierúsalem Ochozíam fílium eius mínimum , regem pro eo :
traditions.KJV: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead :

1.english_reference: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest

traditions.WLC: ו כִּ֤י כָל הָ רִאשֹׁנִים֙ הָרַ֣ג הַ גְּד֔וּד הַ בָּ֥א בָֽ עַרְבִ֖ים לַֽ מַּחֲנֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πάντας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους ἀπέκτεινεν τὸ λῃστήριον τὸ ἐπελθὸν ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς οἱ Ἄραβες οἱ Ἀλειμαζονεῖς ·
traditions.VUL: omnes enim maióres natu , qui ante eum fúerant , interfécerant latrónes Arabum , qui irrúerant in castra :
traditions.KJV: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest .

1.english_reference: So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ὀχοζείας υἱὸς Ἰωρὰμ βασιλέως Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: regnavítque Ochozías fílius Ioram regis Iuda .
traditions.KJV: So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .

2.english_reference: Forty and two years old [ was ] Ahaziah when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וּ שְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὢν εἴκοσι ἐτῶν Ὀχοζείας ἐβασίλευσεν ,
traditions.VUL: Quadragínta duórum annórum erat Ochozías cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Forty and two years old [ was ] Ahaziah when he began to reign ,

2.english_reference: and he reigned one year in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνιαυτὸν ἕνα ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et uno anno regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and he reigned one year in Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Athaliah the daughter of Omri

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ בַּת עָמְרִֽי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Γοθολία θυγάτηρ Ἀμβρεί .
traditions.VUL: et nomen matris eius Athalía fília Amri .
traditions.KJV: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Athaliah the daughter of Omri .

3.english_reference: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: גַּם ה֣וּא הָלַ֔ךְ בְּ דַרְכֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτος ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ οἴκου Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: Sed et ipse ingréssus est per vias domus Achab :
traditions.KJV: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab :

3.english_reference: for his mother was his counseller to do wickedly

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י אִמּ֛ וֹ הָיְתָ֥ה יֽוֹעַצְתּ֖ וֹ לְ הַרְשִֽׁיעַ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι μήτηρ αὐτοῦ ἦν σύμβουλος τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν .
traditions.VUL: mater enim eius ímpulit eum ut ímpie ágeret .
traditions.KJV: for his mother was his counseller to do wickedly .

4.english_reference: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַשׂ הָ רַ֛ע בְּ עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ בֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου ὡς οἶκος Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit ígitur malum in conspéctu Dómini , sicut domus Achab :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab :

4.english_reference: for they were his counsellers after the death of his father to his destruction

traditions.WLC: כִּי הֵ֜מָּה הָֽיוּ ל֣ וֹ יֽוֹעֲצִ֗ים אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת אָבִ֖י ו לְ מַשְׁחִ֥ית לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἦσαν αὐτῷ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ σύμβουλοι τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: ipsi enim fuérunt ei consiliárii post mortem patris sui , in intéritum eius :
traditions.KJV: for they were his counsellers after the death of his father to his destruction .

5.english_reference: He walked also after their counsel

traditions.WLC: גַּ֣ם בַּ עֲצָתָ ם֮ הָלַךְ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ταῖς βουλαῖς αὐτῶν ἐπορεύθη .
traditions.VUL: ambulavítque in consíliis eórum .
traditions.KJV: He walked also after their counsel ,

5.english_reference: and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּלֶךְ֩ אֶת יְהוֹרָ֨ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֜ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַ מִּלְחָמָ֛ה עַל חֲזָאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם בְּ רָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετὰ Ἰωρὰμ υἱοῦ Ἀχαὰβ εἰς πόλεμον ἐπὶ Ἀζαὴλ βασιλέα Συρίας εἰς Ῥαμὰ Γαλαάδ ·
traditions.VUL: Et perréxit cum Ioram fílio Achab rege Israel in bellum contra Házael regem Sýriæ in Ramoth Gálaad :
traditions.KJV: and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּ֥וּ הָֽ רַמִּ֖ים אֶת יוֹרָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξαν οἱ τοξόται τὸν Ἰωράμ .
traditions.VUL: vulneraverúntque Syri Ioram .
traditions.KJV: and the Syrians smote Joram .

6.english_reference: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֜שָׁב לְ הִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְ יִזְרְעֶ֗אל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ἰωρὰμ τοῦ ἰατρευθῆναι εἰς Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Qui revérsus est ut curarétur in Iézrahel :
traditions.KJV: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel

6.english_reference: because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י הַ מַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכֻּ֣ הוּ בָֽ רָמָ֔ה בְּ הִלָּ֣חֲמ֔ וֹ אֶת חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῶν πληγῶν ὧν ἐπάταξαν αὐτὸν οἱ Σύροι ἐν Ῥαμὰ ἐν τῷ πολεμεῖν αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἀζαὴλ βασιλέα Συρίας ·
traditions.VUL: multas enim plagas accéperat in supradícto certámine .
traditions.KJV: because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria .

6.english_reference: And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִ רְא֞וֹת אֶת יְהוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֛ב בְּ יִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּי חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ὀχοζείας υἱὸς Ἰωρὰμ βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα κατέβη θεᾶσθαι τὸν Ἰωρὰμ υἱὸν Ἀχαὰβ εἰς Ἰσραήλ ὅτι ἠρρώστει .
traditions.VUL: Igitur Ochozías fílius Ioram rex Iuda , descéndit ut invíseret Ioram fílium Achab in Iézrahel ægrotántem .
traditions.KJV: And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick .

7.english_reference: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵֽ אֱלֹהִ֗ים הָיְתָה֙ תְּבוּסַ֣ת אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לָ ב֖וֹא אֶל יוֹרָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγένετο καταστροφὴ Ὀχοζείᾳ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς Ἰωράμ ·
traditions.VUL: Voluntátis quippe fuit Dei advérsus Ochozíam , ut veníret ad Ioram :
traditions.KJV: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram :

7.english_reference: for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ בֹא֗ וֹ יָצָ֤א עִם יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶל יֵה֣וּא בֶן נִמְשִׁ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐξελθεῖν ἐξῆλθεν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ Ἰωρὰμ πρὸς υἱὸν Ναμεσσεὶ
traditions.VUL: et cum venísset , et egrederétur cum eo advérsum Iehu fílium Namsi ,
traditions.KJV: for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi ,

7.english_reference: whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְשָׁח֣ וֹ יְהוָ֔ה לְ הַכְרִ֖ית אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָֽב
traditions.LXX: χριστὸν Κυρίου τὸν οἶκον Ἀχαάβ .
traditions.VUL: quem unxit Dóminus ut deléret domum Achab .
traditions.KJV: whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .

8.english_reference: And it came to pass , that , when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֕י כְּ הִשָּׁפֵ֥ט יֵה֖וּא עִם בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξεδίκησεν Ἰοὺ τὸν οἶκον Ἀχαάβ ,
traditions.VUL: Cum ergo evérteret Iehu domum Achab ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , that , when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab ,

8.english_reference: and found the princes of Judah , and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah , that ministered to Ahaziah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְצָא֩ אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וּ בְנֵ֨י אֲחֵ֧י אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים לַ אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὗρον τοὺς Ἰούδα ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς Ὀχοζεία λειτουργοῦντας τῷ Ὀχοζείᾳ
traditions.VUL: invénit príncipes Iuda , et fílios fratrum Ochozíæ , qui ministrábant ei ,
traditions.KJV: and found the princes of Judah , and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah , that ministered to Ahaziah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּהַרְגֵֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: et interfécit illos .
traditions.KJV: he slew them .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבַקֵּשׁ֩ אֶת אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν τοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν Ὀχοζείαν ·
traditions.VUL: Ipsum quoque perquírens Ochozíam ,
traditions.KJV: And he sought Ahaziah :

9.english_reference: and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , )

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּלְכְּדֻ֜ הוּ וְ ה֧וּא מִתְחַבֵּ֣א בְ שֹֽׁמְר֗וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέλαβον αὐτὸν ἰατρευόμενον ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ
traditions.VUL: comprehéndit latitántem in Samaría :
traditions.KJV: and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , )

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִאֻ֣ הוּ אֶל יֵהוּא֮
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἰού ,
traditions.VUL: adductúmque ad se ,
traditions.KJV: and brought him to Jehu :

9.english_reference: and when they had slain him , they buried him

traditions.WLC: וַ יְמִתֻ הוּ֒ וַֽ יִּקְבְּרֻ֔ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν . καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: occídit , et sepeliérunt eum :
traditions.KJV: and when they had slain him , they buried him :

9.english_reference: Because , said they , he [ is ] the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the LORD with all his heart

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ בֶּן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר דָּרַ֥שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ כָל לְבָב֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἶπαν Υἱὸς Ἰωσαφάτ ἐστιν , ὃς ἐζήτησεν τὸν κύριον ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: eo quod esset fílius Iósaphat , qui quæsíerat Dóminum in toto corde suo .
traditions.KJV: Because , said they , he [ is ] the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the LORD with all his heart .

9.english_reference: So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵין֙ לְ בֵ֣ית אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לַ עְצֹ֥ר כֹּ֖חַ לְ מַמְלָכָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν οἴκῳ Ὀχοζεία κατισχῦσαι δύναμιν περὶ τῆς βασιλείας .
traditions.VUL: Nec erat ultra spes áliqua ut de stirpe quis regnáret Ochozíæ :
traditions.KJV: So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .

10.english_reference: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ Γοθολία ἡ μήτηρ Ὀχοζεία εἶδεν ὅτι τέθνηκεν αὐτῆς ὁ υἱός ,
traditions.VUL: síquidem Athalía mater eius , videns quod mórtuus esset fílius suus ,
traditions.KJV: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead ,

10.english_reference: she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֗קָם וַ תְּדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת כָּל זֶ֥רַע הַ מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְ בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα τῆς βασιλείας ἐν οἴκῳ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: surréxit , et interfécit omnem stirpem régiam domus Ioram .
traditions.KJV: she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah .

11.english_reference: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּקַּח֩ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֨ת בַּת הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰωσαβεὲ τὸν Ἰωὰς υἱὸν Ὀχοζεία ,
traditions.VUL: Porro Iósabeth fília regis tulit Ioas fílium Ochozíæ ,
traditions.KJV: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah ,

11.english_reference: and stole him from among the king ’s sons that were slain ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹת וֹ֙ מִ תּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ מּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔκλεψεν αὐτὸν ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν θανατουμένων ,
traditions.VUL: et furáta est eum de médio filiórum regis , cum interficeréntur :
traditions.KJV: and stole him from among the king ’s sons that were slain ,

11.english_reference: and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber .

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛ וֹ וְ אֶת מֵֽינִקְתּ֖ וֹ בַּ חֲדַ֣ר הַ מִּטּ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν τροφὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς ταμεῖον κλινῶν ·
traditions.VUL: abscondítque eum cum nutríce sua in cubículo lectulórum :
traditions.KJV: and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber .

11.english_reference: So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּסְתִּירֵ֡ הוּ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֣ת בַּת הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֡ם אֵשֶׁת֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ כֹּהֵ֜ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔκρυψεν αὐτὸν Ἰωσαβεὲ θυγάτηρ τοῦ βασιλέως Ἰωράμ , ἀδελφὴ Ὀχοζείου καὶ γυνὴ Ἰωδᾶε ·
traditions.VUL: Iósabeth autem , quæ abscónderat eum , erat fília regis Ioram , uxor Ióiadæ pontíficis ,
traditions.KJV: So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest ,

11.english_reference: ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , )

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הִיא֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֲח֧וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ
traditions.VUL: soror Ochozíæ ,
traditions.KJV: ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , )

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔκρυψεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ προσώπου Γοθολίας ,
traditions.VUL: et idcírco Athalía
traditions.KJV: hid him from Athaliah ,

11.english_reference: so that she slew him not .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א הֱמִיתָֽתְ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν .
